title: ❗️ More than 30 ships remain anchored in just one port alone due to closure of the Strait of Hormuz — IRIB
text:
❗️ More than 30 ships remain anchored in just one port alone due to closure of the Strait of Hormuz — IRIB"

"Other ports are seeing similar conditions"

""
"Iran's State TV Reporter: "Here at the port [Bandar Abbas], here at the first anchorage, I counted more than 30 ships that remain anchored and, due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, are inevitably unable to pass. This is only in the first anchorage; the second and third anchorages are the same. These are the vessels that remained and dropped anchor, and the IRGC Navy says that due to the wickedness and mischief of the US terrorist army in guiding and encouraging some vessels to pass through illegal routes in the southern waters of the Persian Gulf, they have closed the Strait of Hormuz, and this strait remains closed.
